title: The Opera Game
players: Paul Morphy vs Duke Karl of Brunswick & Count Isouard
lesson: Development beats material: Morphy gives pieces away to open lines while his opponents' pieces sit at home.

moves.note: Pins the knight, but Black will have to give up this bishop.
White's queen comes out with a developing gain of tempo.
A double attack on f7 and b7.
Morphy develops instead of grabbing b7.
Pins the f6-knight. Every white piece is active.
A sacrifice to open lines against the uncastled king.
The rook joins with tempo on the pinned d7-knight.
Another rook to the d-file — pile up on the pin.
The queen sacrifice: deflecting the d7-knight.
Checkmate with the last two pieces. Black's h8-rook and f8-bishop never moved.
